name: Transportation Sites
description: This dataset lists transportation-eligible sites, primarily schools, in and around New York City, with one row per site per school year. Each record identifies a site by its option code, name, affiliation (such as public, charter, yeshiva, or nonsectarian), and site type (school, pre-K/EI site, or office), along with its street address, city, state, ZIP code, and latitude/longitude coordinates. The data also flags which transportation services apply to each site, including door-to-door service, stop-to-school service, common carrier service with MetroCards, site reimbursement, mid-day service, and late-day programs for door-to-door and stop-to-school routes. Most rows cover the 2016-2017 school year, with smaller shares from adjacent years. The dataset could be used to map school and program locations, compare transportation service availability across boroughs and site types, analyze geographic coverage and gaps in service, or support planning and reporting for student
